company.name: Trade Ghana
company.shortDescription: Trade connects buyers, sellers, and transporters.
company.description:
Trade is a platform that connects buyers, sellers, and transporters of commodities in Ghana.

Trade allows buyers and sellers in Ghana to trade directly, cutting out the middlemen. You pick your quantity, grade, and price and they look for sellers to match you with. They weigh and grade every bag that they trade, deliver directly to you, and will take back any bag you reject, so you can buy without worrying.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that connects buyers with sellers of maize, facilitating the purchase of quality maize through a simple and secure process.
productsAndServices.name: Maize Sourcing Platform

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,575,000, or 96.26% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $100,000, representing 3.74% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,208,051 to $13,208,051, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
